{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing body_mass_g values
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])

# Compute the mean body mass
mean_body_mass = penguins_clean['body_mass_g'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f'Mean body mass (after dropping missing values): {mean_body_mass}')"}
